presentation.name: Keep a configuration form in step with the code that reads it
presentation.summary: Checks that a component's config type, its JSON Schema and its UI schema describe the same fields, so a setting saved in the form is the setting that runs.
benefits: Finds fields the form offers but the code ignores, and settings the form never exposes
Compares required flags, enums, defaults and bounds across all three sources
Moves silent clamps in code into schema bounds the user can see
Catches conditional fields that always show, never validate or break the form when revealed
Reports one inventory row per field, so every finding has its evidence beside it
